announced on Tuesday that it won a $105.6M firm-fixed-price contract modification for Advanced Medium Range Air-to-Air Missiles (AMRAAM) parts purchases.
The work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona, with completion expected by August 31, 2027.
The award includes $61.6M in fiscal 2025 missile procurement funds, $8.4M in fiscal 2025 Navy weapons procurement funds, and $35.7M in FMS funds.
The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center is the contracting activity.

title: RTX secures $105.6M AMRAAM parts deal from U.S. Air Force
